purpose: Audit existing conditional646 / NEXUS39 coverage and conditional saved-quote payout drift. No policy fit, threshold search, purchase recommendations or annual ROI calculation.

source_access.note: The 137 quote records below copy the original conditional ledger values and official payouts; NEXUS rows describe separate raw preclose snapshots, sometimes later than the original saved allocation odds.

conditional.scope: Original conditional top12, established clean cohort 646, 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-19; initial saved allocation quotes only.
conditional.drift_definition: For an originally allocated hit race: sum(official payoff per 100 yen * saved stake/100) / sum(saved odds * saved stake) over the actual winning selected tickets. Misses have no realized winning quote ratio and are not silently assigned zero.
conditional.drift_selection_limit: Hit-conditioned diagnostic, 56 hits in 129 allocated races. It does not estimate drift for all tickets or prove any causal contribution to NEXUS annual ROI. The 0.80 stress factor is a fixed unvalidated hypothesis, not a lower confidence bound inferred here.
conditional.near_close_note: The separate existing near-close file has five further snapshots, all within the same initial137 identities; none is within five minutes of its recorded close. These are not mixed into the initial137 timing/56-hit ratio aggregates.

nexus.scope: Separate NEXUS exact39 replay cohort: 16 races on 2026-10-19 and 23 on 2026-10-20. Full q was reconstructed after results, not originally published.

limitations: These existing outcomes were already inspected; none of these retrospective cohorts is a new untouched annual validation.
137 conditional snapshots quote only the selected twelve tickets. Complete full-market inverse-odds normalization cannot be reconstructed from those selected prices alone.
NEXUS39 and conditional646 use different models/forecasts and cohorts; they are not combined into a performance score.
S/A/B currently uses raw selected model mass thresholds and is not fitted empirical outcome calibration.
Quote lead until close and quote age at decision are different quantities; this audit reports both where the original allocation time exists.
No independent calibrated purchase model or complete annual decision ledger is established by this audit.
